text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents a national-scale (Turkey) spatial land system modeling study using the CLUMondo model to simulate and compare two future scenarios—business-as-usual and a Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) scenario—up to 2050. The primary objective is to assess how LDN implementation influences future land use/land cover (LULC) patterns, making LULC prediction central to the research question. The study explicitly models 14 land system classes at 2×2 km resolution across the entire country, implements multiple future scenarios with quantitative comparison of land system changes, and produces mapped projections of LULC (e.g., Fig. 4). It reports quantitative metrics such as area changes (% of national territory), conversion rates, and attribution of degradation/improvement causes. All core inclusion criteria are met: national-scale spatial implementation, primary focus on LULC simulation, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with explicit outputs, and mapped projections. No exclusion criteria apply—the study is not global, local, species-focused, economic-only, carbon-only, methodological without application, qualitative, or single-scenario.)
